data.description: A burrowing ice elemental can pass through nonmagical ice and snow as easily as a fish swims through water.  Its burrowing leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence.  A control water spell cast on an area containing a burrowing ice elemental flings the elemental back 30 feet, stunning the creature for 1 round unless it succeeds on a DC 15 Fortitude save.
data.name: Ice Glide
